About Me

Hi, I am Shimla Akter

I am a Facebook Ads Specialist with hands on experience running paid campaigns for small and growing businesses. I focus on message based campaigns, sales campaigns and lead generation, using clear targeting and constant testing to keep cost low and results high.

My goal is simple. Every money you spend on ads should bring back a real customer, not just a number on a screen. I plan, launch, watch and improve every campaign until it performs the way it should.

FAQ

Common Questions, Answered

Still curious about something? Feel free to send a message on WhatsApp.

What does a Facebook ads specialist actually do+

I plan, launch and manage Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns to help your business get more messages, leads or sales, based on your goals and budget.

How much budget do I need to start+

You can start with a small daily budget and scale it up once we see which campaigns are performing best for you.

Do you also manage Instagram ads+

Yes. Since Facebook and Instagram share the same ad platform, your campaigns can run on both places at the same time.

How soon can I see results+

Most campaigns start showing early signals within the first week, though stronger results usually build over the first month of testing.

What do you need from me to get started+

Access to your Facebook page and business manager, along with basic information about your product, offer and target audience.

How do we stay in touch during the project+

We can talk over WhatsApp or email, and you will get regular updates on how your campaigns are performing.
